PokemonTower_1F_Text_CameToPrayForDepart.en: I came to pray for my dearly\ndeparted CLEFAIRY.\pSniff!\nI'm awash in tears…
PokemonTower_1F_Text_CameToPrayForDepart.fr: Je suis venu prier pour mon cher\nMÉLOFÉE disparu.\pSnif !\nJe suis noyé de larmes…

PokemonTower_1F_Text_ComeToPayRespectsGi.en: Did you come to pay respects?\pBless your POKéMON-loving heart,\ngirl.
PokemonTower_1F_Text_ComeToPayRespectsGi.fr: Es-tu venue te recueillir ?\pQue Dieu bénisse ton cœur qui aime\nles POKéMON, petite.

PokemonTower_1F_Text_ComeToPayRespectsSo.en: Did you come to pay respects?\pBless your POKéMON-loving heart,\nson.
PokemonTower_1F_Text_ComeToPayRespectsSo.fr: Es-tu venu te recueillir ?\pQue Dieu bénisse ton cœur qui aime\nles POKéMON, fiston.

PokemonTower_1F_Text_ErectedInMemoryOfDe.en: POKéMON TOWER was erected in the\nmemory of POKéMON that died.
PokemonTower_1F_Text_ErectedInMemoryOfDe.fr: La TOUR POKéMON a été érigée à la\nmémoire des POKéMON morts.

PokemonTower_1F_Text_SenseSpiritsUpToMis.en: I am a CHANNELER.\pThere are spirits up to mischief.\nI sense them high in the TOWER.
PokemonTower_1F_Text_SenseSpiritsUpToMis.fr: Je suis un MÉDIUM.\pDes esprits font des farces.\nJe les sens en haut de la TOUR.
